# Motionix — Free AI Tools for Images & Video

> Free, privacy-first browser-based tools for image and video editing. No signup, no uploads — everything runs on your device.

## About

Motionix is a collection of 8 free AI-powered tools that run entirely in the user's browser. Images and videos never leave the device. Tools are powered by ONNX Runtime, HTML Canvas, and WebCodecs — no server-side processing required.

## Tools

- [Background Remover](https://motionix.xyz/tools/background-remover) — Remove backgrounds from photos using an on-device ISNet AI model. Supports JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, AVIF.
- [Passport Photo Maker](https://motionix.xyz/tools/passport-photo-maker) — Create compliant passport and ID photos with country-specific sizing for US, UK, India, and Schengen.
- [Student ID Photo Maker](https://motionix.xyz/tools/student-id-photo-maker) — Generate school and university ID photos in standard dimensions.
- [Resume Photo Maker](https://motionix.xyz/tools/resume-photo-maker) — Create professional headshot photos for CVs, resumes, and LinkedIn profiles.
- [Signature Maker](https://motionix.xyz/tools/signature-maker) — Draw or type a digital signature and export as transparent PNG.
- [Photo Resizer](https://motionix.xyz/tools/photo-resizer) — Resize images to exact pixel or file-size targets.
- [Image Compressor](https://motionix.xyz/tools/image-compressor) — Compress JPG, PNG, and WebP file sizes with quality-targeted compression.
- [Video Compressor](https://motionix.xyz/tools/video-compressor) — Compress MP4, MOV, MKV, and WebM videos using browser-native WebCodecs.

## Tech Stack

- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router) with TypeScript
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS v4
- **AI Runtime**: ONNX Runtime Web (client-side inference)
- **Video Processing**: WebCodecs API via Mediabunny
- **Image Processing**: HTML Canvas API
- **Authentication**: Clerk (optional, env-gated)
- **Analytics**: GA4, Plausible, Microsoft Clarity (env-gated)
- **Deployment**: Vercel
- **i18n**: next-intl (English, French, German, Hindi, Japanese, Chinese Simplified)

## Multilingual Support

Available in: English (en), Français (fr), Deutsch (de), हिंदी (hi), 日本語 (ja), 简体中文 (zh-cn)
